annotation.colors.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (Okabe-Ito hues, one per annotation kind)

references.url_timeout_s.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (seconds per URL reachability check)

references.max_retries.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (retries of a reachability check)

references.max_redirects.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (redirects followed while checking one URL)

reports.id_prefix.provenance: specified by the design of the working folder (report ids look like R01)

reports.id_digits.provenance: specified by the design of the working folder (R01 to R99 in a batch)

reports.page_digits.provenance: specified by the design of the working folder (page files look like p001)

reports.meta_file_name.provenance: specified by the preparation contract of issue 122 (spec, Data contracts): language, excluded pages and text quality of one report

reports.elements_file_name.provenance: specified by the preparation contract of issue 122 (spec, Data contracts): the element records of one report

reports.figures_folder.provenance: the folder the figure step reads (ugs_figures.figures_report), kept equal to it by the same name

text.excluded_folder.provenance: specified by spec R7: the original text of an excluded page is kept in this folder beside the pages

text.excluded_marker.provenance: specified by spec R7: the one line that replaces the text of an excluded page in its page file; {reason} is the reason code of page_roles (cover, signature_table, version_table)

text.min_replacement_chars.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (a page holding fewer Unicode replacement characters keeps its text layer; one such character can be a real symbol)

text.min_words_per_page.provenance: proposal 2026-11-17, a page with fewer words than this is treated as having no text layer; tune on counts

tables.min_anchor_chars.provenance: proposal 2026-11-17, an anchor shorter than this cannot prove the table is already in the text; tune on counts

tables.image_column_gap_pt.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25, a horizontal gap of this many points between two words starts a new column of a table drawn as an image; tune on the real reports

tables.image_min_rows.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25, a table drawn as an image needs at least this many rows of words to be taken as a table; tune on the real reports

tables.untitled_min_rows.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25 (plan 11 E5), an untitled region is a table drawn as an image only when its OCR rebuilds at least this many rows; tune on the real reports

tables.untitled_min_cols.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25 (plan 11 E5), an untitled region is a table drawn as an image only when its OCR rebuilds at least this many columns of non-empty cells; a two-column label grid is a diagram in the real reports (plan 17, first run: 12 untitled regions of R01 wrongly tables at 2); tune on the real reports

tables.titled_min_rows.provenance: measured 2026-11-26 on R01 (plan 20 review D): the grid of each owner-listed titled table holds at least three rows of five non-empty cells; the untitled grid rule keeps its own keys

tables.titled_min_cols.provenance: measured 2026-11-26 on R01 (plan 20 review D): with five columns the rule flags the owner-listed titled tables and no other titled figure of R01 except the one with no text layer; at three columns it flagged F9, F10, F13 and F15 (at most two full rows at five cells) which the owner does not list

tables.titled_min_words.provenance: measured 2026-11-26 on R01 (plan 20 review 6): the regions of the owner-listed titled figures hold 22 to 450 words where a table has text, and the one region with no text layer and no OCR words (F7) holds none; a region under ten words is unreadable, and the smallest measured figure with words holds 17

tables.image_row_overlap_ratio.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25 (review M2), two words join one row when their boxes overlap vertically by this share of the smaller box; tune on the real reports

text.ocr_dpi.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (resolution of the OCR of a damaged page, the usual resolution for printed text; the same figure as the probe of text_quality)

pages.small_image_max_area_ratio.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (largest share of the page area an image may cover to count as a small image, such as a logo, when a page is excluded)

batch.outlier_z.provenance: chosen by the professor (a grade whose |z| exceeds this value is an outlier)

driver.audit_retries.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (re-asks of the auditor role after a refusal)

driver.request_timeout_s.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (seconds per bridge call, a local model is slow)

driver.count_timeout_s.provenance: measured prefill of about 130 tokens per second, so 1200 seconds covers about 150000 tokens, adjustable by the professor

roles.grader.provenance: model role name, read from the configuration; the model behind the name is chosen by the professor

roles.auditor.provenance: model role name, read from the configuration; the model behind the name is chosen by the professor

roles.vision.provenance: model role name, read from the configuration; the model behind the name is chosen by the professor

driver.reply_reserve_tokens.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (tokens held for one JSON answer: a normalized rubric of about a dozen items is the largest)

driver.max_image_bytes.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (bytes, largest image file attached to one request)

driver.image_tokens_fallback.provenance: computed: ceil(1568/28) * ceil(1568/28) patches for the largest allowed image, used until vision_probe has measured the local model

grade.score_step.provenance: chosen by the session 2026-11-26 (plan 25, Task 1): points are the level fraction times the maximum, rounded to the nearest multiple of this step (ties up); quarter points keep 0.88 x 0.5 = 0.44 distinct from 0.5 only when rounded, and 0.88 x 10 = 8.8 becomes 8.75

grade.quote_min_chars.provenance: starting value, unmeasured, adjustable by the professor (review round 2): the shortest normalised quote the key tier accepts; a shorter key is too weak for a substring test

grade.quote_min_word_share.provenance: chosen by the owner (review round 2, 2026-11-26): the share of the quote words the fuzzy tier must find in order in its window

grade.quote_window_factor.provenance: chosen by the owner (review round 2, 2026-11-26): the fuzzy window is about this many times the quote word count

grade.unverified_present_counts_as.provenance: chosen by the session 2026-11-27 under the owner's review of round 2: an element marked present whose quote no tier verifies counts as this verdict in the level

grade.quote_min_words.provenance: starting value, unmeasured, adjustable by the professor (review round 2): a quote shorter than this many words never verifies, in any tier

grade.quote_page_window.provenance: chosen by the owner (review round 2, 2026-11-26): a quote is searched on its named page and this many pages either side, never further

grade.quote_max_words.provenance: chosen by the session 2026-11-27 under the owner's review of round 2: twice the 12 words the prompt asks for; a longer quote skips the fuzzy tier (resource cap)

grade.max_elements.provenance: starting value, unmeasured, adjustable by the professor (review round 2): elements beyond this count in one item are ignored and counted, a resource cap on the verification

grade.missing_max_chars.provenance: starting value, proposed 2026-11-17 and adjustable by the professor: longest missing-element text kept in grade.json, in characters. A bound on one saved field, never on what the model is shown

grade.invalid_answer_retries.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (repeats of a grader call after a refused answer)

select.min_word_len.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (letters; shorter words are ignored when matching a rubric item to page headings)

references.quote_chars.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (characters of a reference entry used to anchor its annotation)

rubric.section_heading_regex.provenance: chosen 2026-11-15 from the professor's own rubric, whose sections are headed `## 3. Title (/10)`; adjustable by the professor for another heading style (named groups n, title and points)

rubric.total_regex.provenance: chosen 2026-11-15 from the professor's own rubric, which states `**Total : 28.5 points**`; adjustable by the professor (named group total)

rubric.min_check_words.provenance: chosen 2026-11-15: a rubric line shorter than four words is a heading or a label, so only longer lines are checked against the text a model rebuilt; adjustable by the professor

language.comment_min_words.provenance: chosen by the session 2026-11-26 under the owner's delegation: a shorter comment is too short for detect_language and is kept as written (words of a comment, R01 case 3)

vision.min_word_share.provenance: chosen 2026-11-15: a figure of a report is read when four words out of five of the text printed on it are found, so one misread word does not stop the step; adjustable by the professor (a number above 0 and at most 1)

vision.kind_aliases.provenance: chosen 2026-11-15 from the professor's list of figures a report can hold (UML, SysML, flowchart, logigram, software or electronic architecture, project breakdown structure, Gantt, Kanban, budget, S-curve, timesheet): the words the professor writes as the expected kind of a figure in the vision probe, each mapped to the schema kind the model answers; a table or a board has no criterion of its own so it is `other`; adjustable by the professor 2026-11-26 (review H, #126): a table, a budget table, a budget, a timesheet, a time sheet and a spreadsheet are the kind table, which the figure criteria judge; they were other.

rubric.element_regexes.provenance: owner rubric format, 2026-11-27: the first rule is the checklist line of the rubric, the second the top-level numbered point (its bold label kept as the element name, the number dropped); bullets without a checkbox are not elements; the first rule that matches at least one line of a section gives that section its elements, in rubric order

rubric.loose_heading_regex.provenance: chosen 2026-11-15, narrowed to the heading levels 1 and 2 after review round 2 (a numbered sub-heading of level 3 or more inside a section is part of that section): a heading that starts with a number and a point is a section of the rubric, so one the strict heading pattern did not read (no points, another way to write them) is refused instead of being absorbed into the previous item; adjustable by the professor

checks.right_zone_ratio.provenance: starting value, adjustable by the professor (share of the page width beyond which a word shaped (n) or (n.m) counts as an equation number; a number above 0 and below 1; a body year such as (2023) sits left of this share in running text)

checks.max_gap_numbers.provenance: proposal 2026-11-17, a gap longer than this is listed by its first numbers and a count of the omitted ones; tune on the counts of the real reports

checks.max_number.provenance: proposal 2026-11-17, a figure, table or equation number above this is refused rather than read, so a report citing a very large number cannot build an unbounded list
